description: Fill the calendar with tentative networking-event holds for the next ~60 days — the user's recurring anchors plus fresh local finds inside their travel radius, previewed inline then added (or handed over to add).

swapPoints.prompt: What city (or town) is your home base for finding local events? This anchors every search and the travel-radius filter.
How far will you travel for an event? (e.g. '30 min drive' or '25 miles')
Which calendar should events go on? 'google' (auto-adds as tentative holds with a Yes/No/Maybe RSVP), 'outlook', 'other', or 'none' (I'll just give you a list to add yourself).
What email should I add you as a guest under, so each Google hold shows the Yes/No/Maybe RSVP prompt? (optional; Google calendar only)
List any recurring rooms you reliably attend (name + cadence like '1st Tuesday' + venue). Leave empty to start — we'll build this list as you find rooms you keep going back to.
Any local event sources you already know about (chamber calendar, a Meetup group, a coworking hub's events page)? Optional — paste URLs.
